summary.name: Voctro Labs
summary.one_liner: Voctro Labs is an audio company offering a cloud voice API and SDKs for speech and singing voice, custom synthesis voices, and the VOCALOID singing synthesizer lineage.
use_cases: Adding voice interaction to mobile or desktop apps
Creating custom synthetic voices for artists or celebrities
Producing singing voice content with virtual singers
Customizing voice and audio algorithms for a project
Industrial or academic voice research collaboration
summary.what_it_does: Voiceful is described as a toolkit for designing digital and mobile experiences with speech and singing voice, offering a cloud-based API and SDK libraries for mobile, tablet and desktop applications. The company says it can create custom synthesis voices for celebrities and artists and customize its voice and audio algorithms for specific projects. The page credits its founders with co-developing VOCALOID, Yamaha's singing voice synthesizer first commercialized in 2003, and names the virtual singers Bruno, Clara and MAIKA as VOCALOID products. Voctro Labs was founded in 2011 by four audio experts and collaborates with industrial and academic partners.
notable: Cloud API and SDKs for speech and singing voice in apps
Co-developed VOCALOID singing synthesizer with Yamaha R&D and Universitat Pompeu Fabra
Custom synthesis voices for celebrities and artists
Founded in 2011; partly funded by Spain's CDTI (VONEXT project)
caveats: Pricing not stated; page asks visitors to message for a quote
Custom voice and algorithm work is by project quote, not a self-serve product
